text: The colour card of the digitisation: a chart of 24 colour patches («24ColorCard») in a holder labelled «APRIL2013», a white patch, a card marked «LEFT», and an angled ruler in inches and centimetres, on a black ground. Not part of the book; the navigation PDF of the Internet Archive omits this image.
The front cover of the binding, of dark, textured cloth, without lettering on the side; photographed in low light.
Nothing of the edition is printed on this page.

A flyleaf without printed matter of the edition, over which the digitisation has set its notice: the drawing of a temple front, «Digitized by the Internet Archive in 2016» and «https://archive.org/details/b24872489». Not part of the book.
Blank.

The title page, unnumbered (p. [I]): the title, «The astronomical tables of Muḥammad ibn Mūsā al-Khwārizmī in the recension of Maslama ibn Aḥmad al-Majrīṭī and the Latin translation of Adelard of Bath, on the preliminary work of A. Bjørnbo (dead, †) and R. Besthorn in Copenhagen, edited with a commentary by H. Suter in Zurich»; the series, Det Kongelige Danske Videnskabernes Selskabs Skrifter, 7th series, historical and philosophical section, III. 1; Copenhagen, sold by Andr. Fred. Høst & Søn, the royal court bookseller, printed by Bianco Luno, 1914.

Types: L01, L03, L05, L07 (but «von»), L09 (but «und») and L12 in capitals; L02, L04, L06, L08, L10, L11 and L13 in small capitals; L14 in capitals and small capitals; L12 «H. SUTER» and L15 «KØBENHAVN» are letter-spaced; L16 is set in a sans-serif type. A short rule stands between L13 and L14, and a small ornament, a rule with a knot in the middle, between L14 and L15. The diacritics of the names are printed: the dots under H (L03, L05) and T (L05), and the macrons (L03, L05).
Large stains of damp run down from the top of the page and through the middle of its lower half; the print is legible throughout.
Nothing is printed on the back of the title page; large stains of damp run down from the top, as on the title page (JP2 0005).

The first page of the contents, unnumbered (p. [III]). L01 «INHALT» is letter-spaced, with a short rule below it; L11 «Kapitel des Kommentars» is set in a larger type. The entries are joined to their page numbers by dotted leaders, the chapters of the commentary also to the numbers of their tables, in a second column headed «Tab.» (L13); chapter 1 has no table number.
The chapters of the commentary are numbered as the chapters of the Latin text, «denen des lateinischen Textes entsprechend»; «Einleitung des Textes» (L14) has no number.

The second page of the contents, unnumbered (p. [IV]). L05 and L06 are one entry run over two lines; L07 and L08 (chapters 27 and 28) fill the line and have no dotted leader. Chapter 32 is listed with chapter 36 (L16), after chapter 35; there is no separate entry for it. A short rule closes the contents, centred below the last entry.
L01: the head of the first column is printed «Pag,» with a comma; see the critical note.

The first page of the foreword; the page number, V by the contents, is not printed. L01 «VORWORT» in capitals, with a short rule below it. L02 opens with a large initial D, standing on the base line of the line and rising above it.

At the foot of the page, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «II» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

Spaced type (gesperrt), marked {sp:}: the names «Björnbo» (L03, L06, L11, L16), «Besthorn» (L11) and «Athelhard» (L13), and «erstens», «zweitens», «drittens» (L14, L15, L18); italics: «Oxford», «Chartres», «Paris» (L08), «Madrid» (L13), «Chartres» (L15) and «Skrifter» (L22).
The title page (JP2 0005) spells the name «BJØRNBO», with ø; the foreword prints «Björnbo», with ö.
The page number «VI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

Spaced type: the names «Andersen» (L01), «Billeter» (L02) and «Pechüle» (L04); «Athelhard’sche» (L12) is not spaced. L07: «Nachtrag 1)» refers to the first of the editor's additions (pp. 233–237), the figure and the bracket in the type of the text, not raised. L15: the signature «H. Suter.» in italics at the right, a little below the line of the place and date (L14).

The first page of the introduction; the page number, VII by the contents, is not printed. L01 «EINLEITUNG» in capitals, with a short rule below it; L02 opens with a large initial S, standing on the base line and rising above the line. At the foot, the signature «II*» on the right.

The note numbers are raised figures followed by a bracket on the line, «1)»; transcribed {sup:1}). The names and a few other words are set in spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Chasles», «Athelhard», «Al-Khwārizmīs», «Maslama al-Madjrīṭī», «Ibn al Ḳifṭī», «Ibn Abī Uṣaibiʿa», «Ḳāḍī Ibn Ṣāʿid», «Yezdegirds», «muhammedanische» (L14), «Haskins», «Björnbo»; italics: the titles, «Aera», «Arin» and «Cordova». The transliteration prints dots under Ḳ, ṭ, ṣ, ḍ, Ṣ, macrons on ā, ī, and the ʿayn as a small raised reversed comma, ʿ.
L10: a dark speck at mid-height between the h and the w of «Al-Khwāriz-»; not transcribed. Band below L17: the dot under the ṭ of «Al-Madjrīṭīs».
The page number «VIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L17 and L20 «Al-Ma’mūns» and L32 «fī’l-djebr wa’l-muḳābala»: the hamza and the elided article are printed as an apostrophe, ’. L21 and N03 «Muh.» are printed without a dot under the h, where L16 has «Muḥammed». N01: the mark over the u of the first «Abū» is printed thin and broken, so that it looks curved; read as the macron of «Abū ʿAbdallāh» in the same line. L22-L23 and L23: the German quotation marks, „ and “.
L31: dark specks after the point of «B.», above and below the line; not transcribed. Spaced type and italics as marked; L16 «1.» numbers the first biography, in the type of the text.
The page number «IX» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

N01: «Al-Ḫuwārizmī», in Nallino's transliteration, with an arc under the H (ḫ). L10 «2.» numbers the second biography. L30 «Astronomen“.“»: the inner quotation closes before the full stop, the outer after it.
L37: a dark speck at mid-height between «beachtung» and «der»; not transcribed.
The page number «X» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.
L30: «Contractus» is printed with the ct ligature of the type, c and t joined by an arc above; transcribed as two letters. L25: the r and v after the folio numbers are raised, recto and verso.
N07: «151– 152», a short dash followed by a space, where N01 and N03 print the long dash between the figures without a space («493—494», «109—110»); transcribed as printed.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck above the hyphen of «kom-» (L31); mid-height specks between «de» and «France» (N03) and between «kleinere» and «Hälfte» (L36).
The page number «XI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L31: the dash of «1—5» is printed in two pieces, 16 and 21 px long with a gap of 5 px, together 42 px, where the dash of «31—37» in the same line is one stroke of 45 px; a broken long dash, transcribed as one. L03 «Björnbo» is in the type of the text, not spaced; L12 «Björnbo» is spaced. L04 and N02-N03: the figures after M are lowered, M₁, M₂, M₃. L06: the r and v after the folio numbers are raised.
N02: the first e of «verschiedener» is printed upside down, ə; see the critical note.
Marks not transcribed: mid-height specks between «lichsten» and «Dank» (L18) and between «in» and «schwarz» (L21).

The page number «XII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01 continues the sentence of p. XI (JP2 0015, L35): Robert of Chester names himself in the first sentence of N as the one who arranged the translation, «et per rodbertum cestrensem ordine digestus».

L14: between «68» and the raised v of «68v» stands a thin vertical stroke at the height of the raised letters, thinner than the strokes of the letters, probably the edge of a spacing sort; not transcribed. L21-L24: the Latin quotations from N are in italics; «Rogerio Herefordensi» (L22) is spaced, not italic.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck at mid-height between «Ausnahmen» and «durch» (L37); a speck after the dash at the beginning of L12; a speck between «von» and «C.» (L32).

The page number «XIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «III» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L25-L28: the passage of Hermannus Dalmata is quoted in italics, the names in it («Albatene», «Alchoarismus», «Roberti») spaced in roman type. L01-L03: Robert's Latin renderings of the Arabic terms of C and O: dakaicae minuta, eltheniae secunda, elwacat medius cursus, tadil coaequatio, elgeib sinus, elfelek elmustakim circulus aequatorialis or aequinoctialis.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck below the m of «quidem» (L26) and one between «mei» and «industria» (L27); a light mark after «Lateinische» (N01).
The page number «XIV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L11-L14 and L31-L36: two small tables, set in columns: «für», the word of C and O in italics, «stets» (or «bisweilen», «meistens»), the word of N in italics; the low double commas „ are ditto marks, standing for «für» and for «stets» of the line above. Each printed row is one line here.

L17-L28: the twelve month names of N, printed in two columns of six rows, the first six months in the left column and the last six in the right; transcribed column by column (@cl, @cr), the left column first. The footnote mark of «Rabbe» and «Jumedi», «1)», refers to N01: the two months of each name are written without the numbers I and II that distinguish them.
The page number «XV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «III*» on the right.

L04-L15: the table of N, set within a ruled frame of two columns, a double rule on the left and the right and a single rule between the columns; the month names in italics in the first column, and in the second, for the number of the days, which the table does not give, a row of nine dots in each row, about 20 px apart, transcribed as dots separated by spaces. Each row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|».

L25: «fol. 9{sub:r}»: the r is printed below the line, where L17 and L36 print the r and v of the folios raised; transcribed as printed. L23: the dash of «302—307» is printed in two pieces, as on p. XI (JP2 0015, L31); transcribed as one long dash. L29-L30: the radix in years, months and days, «9a11m9d» and «9a11m4d», the a, m and d raised; the figures are set without spaces (the gaps between them, 10-13 px, are those between the two figures of «11»).
Marks not transcribed: a dark mark on the k of «hinzukommenden» (L24) and one on the k of «kommt» (L25), in the ink of the print; a light speck at the right of the head of «Radix» (L29).

L25-L28: «Anni iazdeiardi (Yezdegirdi) post aeram arabum», the years of Yazdegerd after the Arab era; the radix that al-Battānī's column gives, 9 years 11 months 9 days, differs from that of N's column, and table 1 has the wrong radix 9 years 11 months 4 days.
The page number «XVI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L06-L09: the four rows of column C as they should read, set centred in four columns, the years, months and days each followed by a point, the parts of the day as fractions with a raised numerator and a lowered denominator, ¹/₄, ³/₄, ¹/₂ (transcribed {sup:1}/{sub:4} etc.).

L14-L46: the three columns that N adds to table 3, set as a table between a double rule above and a double rule below the heads, with double vertical rules between the groups A, B and C and single rules between their columns. Each row of the table is one line here, its thirteen cells separated by our «|»; the heads are given in three rows (L14 the groups, L15 the heads of the columns, L16 the heads of the subcolumns), a head that spans several columns standing in the first of them and the others left empty. «Anni collecti» (A and C) and «Anni residui» (B) are printed turned through a right angle, reading upwards, in two lines, and span L15-L16; «Anni iazdeiardi post aeram arabum» (A) and «Anni diocletiani completi» (C) are printed in two lines. Rows L41-L46 have only the cells of B; the columns A and C end with the year 690.

Column A has «iazdeiardi», column B «iezdeiardi». The rows marked a) (L22) and b) (L39) are those of L04-L05: 488 for 483 and 997 for 977. The parts of the day in column C are fractions with a raised numerator and a lowered denominator.

Checked: the years, months and days of A follow from the radix 9 years 11 months 9 days (3624 days) and 10631 days to every thirty Arab years, with Persian years of 365 days and months of 30 days, in every row; the radix printed in A is 9 11 4 (see p. XV, JP2 0019, L29-L30). The rows of B follow from Arab years of 354 days, 355 in the years 2, 5, 7, 10, 13, 16, 18, 21, 24, 26 and 29 of the cycle, in every row but year 27, where the table has 19 days for 18, as the text says (p. XV, L34-L35). In C the months 12, 13, 14 and 16 of the last four rows are not reduced to years (see L06-L09), and the days are displaced by one row, as the text says (L11-L13).

Marks not transcribed: raised spacing material printed as small dark blocks between «sollte» and «es» (L04), «Zahlen» and «der» (L11) and «Zeile» and «von» (L12); a mark after «post» in the head of A (L15) and a dot on the rule below the heads under «Menses» of A.
The page number «XVII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L06-L31: the table of N, between a double rule above and a double rule below its heads, with single vertical rules between the six columns: «Notae», «Anni arab.», «Anni dom. collecti» (in two lines), «Menses», «Dies», «Fract.»; each row is one line here, its cells separated by our «|». The column «Notae» is empty in the last three rows (L29-L31), which Suter says a later hand added (L35-L37). L13: «824a)», the year that L32 corrects to 854. L26: «2?», the question mark printed in the table.

Checked: the Christian year of each row is the year completed when the thirty Arab years end, counted from the epoch of 16 July 622, in every row but L13 (824 for 854, as the text says). The months are the completed months of the date at which the years end (in the Julian calendar), in every row but L30, the year 720, where the date is 31 January and the table has 1 month 4 days; the days agree in three rows only (30, 270 and 540, L07, L15, L24), and Suter says that the days are often wrong (L33-L34).

L38: «quoque (?)»: the bracketed question mark, upright, stands after a gap of 12 px, where the word spaces of the line are about 27 px; the colons and semicolons of the page stand after the thin space of the edition (9-14 px), in the italic Latin as in the German.
Marks not transcribed: a dark wedge-shaped mark, 34 by 8 px, above the 0 of the column «Fract.» in L10, in the ink of the print; a dot at the left margin before L01.
The page number «XVIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L02 end the marginal note of fol. 9r begun on p. XVII (JP2 0021, L38-L40).

L02 and L17: «(?)», upright, after a gap of 10 px from the italic word before it (a thin space, as before the colons); L21 «(sic)» upright. L03: the omission in the quotation is printed as three points about 18 px apart, as on p. XI (JP2 0015, L09); transcribed «. . .». L26: the dash of «9—20» is printed in two pieces, as on p. XI; transcribed as one long dash. N05: «XXXIV–XXXV» has a short dash (30 px), where N02 «1825—26» and «426—430» have the long dash (41 px).
L32-L34: the seconds and minutes of arc are printed with the double and single prime, «18″», «4′ 49″»; L29, L36, L37: the h of the hours raised, «5h», «4h».
Marks not transcribed: a small comma-shaped speck above the B of «Bekanntlich» (L06) and a light speck above «dicta» (L03).

The page number «XIX» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L02 end Suter's discussion of Robert of Chester's adiectiones begun on p. XVIII (JP2 0022, L21-L37); the minutes and seconds of arc are printed with the single and double prime.

L06-L14: the table of N, between a double rule above and a double rule below its head, with single vertical rules between the columns: «collecti» over the years, «medio die Cordubae» (at noon at Cordova) over the signs, degrees, minutes and seconds of the mean motion of the node; each row is one line here, its cells separated by our «|». L09: «50 ?», the question mark printed in the table.

Checked: from row to row the values grow by 6 signs 23° 27′ 42″ or 43″ (the mean motion of the node in thirty Arab years), in every step but those before and after 420; with that step the seconds of 420 would be 6, not 50, and 450 follows from 6 as from the other rows. Suter's question mark stands at this value.

L16-L17: thirty figures, for the thirty single years of table 20. L23: «(od. una)», «or una», Suter's alternative reading, the parenthesis and «od.» in roman type. L24: «(?)», upright, after a thin space.
Marks not transcribed: the outline of a spacing sort, printed lightly as a bracket, between «Medialitas» and «draconis» (L05).

The page number «XX» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L04 end no. 11, begun at the foot of p. XIX (JP2 0023, L37-L38): N gives the conjunctions and oppositions also for the years 541 and 571, which Suter does not reproduce.

The notes of N are quoted in italics, with Suter's words in roman between them; «(?)» (L06) upright. L20: the a of «mediam» is of a different design from the italic a of the line, taller and more upright, a sort of another fount; transcribed as a. The colons and semicolons of the Latin stand after the thin space of the edition, as in the German (6-13 px measured).
N03: «Im Text mediates»: the text of the note has «mediates», which the quotation (L33) gives as «medietates».

The page number «XXI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «IV» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

The words of the notes of O are printed in italics as they stand in the manuscript, each followed by a point; the readings proposed for them in italics with the dots under ḥ, ḳ, ṣ, ṭ, the macrons and the ʿayn as a raised reversed comma (L29, L38). L15 «vveli» and L26 «kavvekib» have two italic v's, where «wanuczeni» (L15) has the italic w. L28 «Kullu’l-» and L37-L38 «unshi’a»: the apostrophe after the i stands beside the dot of the i.

The page number «XXII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L08 end the explanation of the note of O fol. 127v begun on p. XXI (JP2 0025, L26-L41): Merkur stands for Iblīs because Hermes was identified with Hermes Trismegistos and Thoth.

L08: after «Wort1).» a second point stands on the base line, 35 px to the right, as dark and as large as the full stop before it (7 by 6 px, darkest pixel 15); transcribed as printed, see the critical note.

L31: the m of «nämlich» is printed broken, its last arch and stem faint, so that the word looks like «nänılich»; transcribed «nämlich». N03: the italic capital F of «Fēs» and «Fās» is heavier than the rest of the words; transcribed as italics.
Marks not transcribed: a speck at the right of the page number; a small mark, like the corner of a spacing sort, at the upper left of the d of «dem» (L27).
The page number «XXIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «IV*» on the right.

L15, N03, N06: the three signs for zero are printed as a Greek small tau, τ, a narrow oval with a crossbar, θ, and the figure 0 with a bar above it, {ov:0} (transcribed {ov:0}). L17 «XXX0» and «XX0» and L19 «0» are the figure zero without a bar. L15: «theta ?», the question mark, upright, after a thin space of 10 px.

N07-N10: the abbreviations and their expansions are set in a heavier italic than the other italics of the notes (strokes measured on the scan: horizontal runs of ink, mean 5.3-5.6 px in «Dakaicae», «Theniae», «Puncta», «Minuta», 4.9 px in «Min.», against 4.3-4.6 px in «Prologus», «Ocreati» and «Sec.»); transcribed as bold italic, «Sec.» (N10) as italic. The distinction for «Min.» is the least certain.
Marks not transcribed: a speck at the right margin beside L07, after «oft».
The page number «XXIV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L35: «Kh.» is letter-spaced (10 px between K and h, where the letters of «stets» stand 2-4 px apart), as are «Batt.», «Ptolemäus» and «Ptol.» (L36) and the names. L02: «Sig. Gr. Min. Sec.», the four abbreviations of the edition, in roman type.
Marks not transcribed: specks in the right margin beside the page number, beside L32 and beside N01 and N03, and one in the left margin before L07; a small mark above the n of «in» (L23).
The page number «XXV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The introduction ends with L22; the rest of the page is blank.

L10: the final s of «alemannisches» is broken, its lower part not printed, with a light stain beside it; transcribed «alemannisches». L18: «minutae» and «secundae» in roman type, the Arabic words in italics.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck in the left margin between L05 and L06, before «sischen».
Blank. The text of p. XXV shows through the leaf, mirrored; damp stains run down from the top; small specks.
The part title, unnumbered, before the Latin text: the word «TEXT», letter-spaced capitals, alone a little above the middle of the page. Damp stains run down from the top.
Blank. Damp stains run down from the top.

The first page of the Latin text; the page number, 1, is not printed at the head. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «1» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L01-L02: the title, «Incipit ezich Elkaurezmi per Athelardum Bathoniensem ex arabico sumptus», in a larger type, centred, with a short rule below it. In the right margin beside it the folios of the four manuscripts at which the text begins: Mazarine (M) 82 recto, Chartres (C) 41 recto, Oxford (O) 99 verso, Madrid (N) 8 recto; transcribed as margin notes.

The apparatus (N01-N13), in a smaller type, gives the readings of the manuscripts by their sigla C, O, M and N; the lemma closes with a square bracket; «om.» (omitted), «suprascr.» (written above) and the remarks of the editor in italics. N01: the omission in the lemma is printed as four points, in N04, N05 and N07 as three. The text and the apparatus follow the editor's principles of p. XXIII (JP2 0027): ae for the e of the manuscripts, v for consonantal u, t for c before i and a vowel.
N01: the semicolons of the apparatus stand after a thin space (9 px), as in the German pages.
The page number «2» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L06 and L20: the chapter headings, «Cap. 1. Descriptio anni arabum.» and «Cap. 2. Descriptio anni romanorum.», in a bold roman type, centred; in the left margin beside them the folios of M and N at which the chapters begin, «M 83r» and «N 8v». L02: «Ptolomaei» is letter-spaced, «elmagesti» in italics; the Arabic words of the text (elkebice, elmuharram, zafar, dulheia) are in italics.

N02: the D of «De» is printed broken, only its stem and the right part of its bowl visible; transcribed «De». N04: «XXlIII», the third numeral a lower-case l, taller than the I's and with a slanting head serif; transcribed as printed (see the critical note). N05: the s of «suprascr.» is upright, the rest of the word italic; N10: the c of «cum» is italic, the rest of the word upright; transcribed as printed. N08: «partes. erunt», a full stop where the sentence goes on; transcribed as printed. N10: «CCCL[I]V», the square brackets the editor's, supplying the I that O lacks.
N01: «(S.)», the editor's initial, marks a reading of his own. The semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (8-11 px measured).
Marks not transcribed: a light mark above the o of «vero» (L11) and a light speck above the last e of «positione» (N13).
The page number «3» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «1*» on the right.

L23 and N14: «{ov:II}DCCXCIII», the two I's under one bar, which multiplies them by a thousand: 2793 years from the Flood to Alexander; the M of note 35 has the same figures without the bar. L29: the vertical bar between «suppositam» and «praenotavimus» marks the beginning of fol. 41 verso of C, which the note in the right margin, «C 41v», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L17: the square bracket before «Quoniam» is the editor's; no closing bracket stands on this page. The names «Noae», «Alexandrum» and «Alexandro» (L22-L24) are letter-spaced; the Arabic words and «era» and «domini» are in italics.

Columns 6 and 7 give the lords of the four triplicities, by day and by night: the sun, Jupiter and Saturn by day, Jupiter, the sun and Saturn by night for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius; Venus, the moon and Mars, the moon, Venus and Mars for Taurus, Virgo and Capricornus; Saturn, Mercury and Jupiter, Mercury, Saturn and Jupiter for Gemini, Libra and Aquarius; Venus, Mars and the moon, Mars, Venus and the moon for Cancer, Scorpius and Pisces. Every line agrees with this scheme.

The lower part: the lords of the faces, the three parts of 10° of each sign, follow the order Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the sun, Venus, Mercury, the moon from Mars in the first face of Aries to Mars in the last face of Pisces, as Suter says (p. 104, JP2 0136, L29-L40). The terms, «Fines secundum Medos», divide each sign among the five planets; the five numbers of each sign add up to 30°, and in eleven of the signs they are the terms that Suter recognises as the system Nallino ascribes to the Egyptians (p. 105, JP2 0137, L01-L12), the Egyptian terms of Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos, beginning with Jupiter 6°, Venus 6°, Mercury 8°, Mars 5°, Saturn 5° in Aries. In Aquarius (L29) the table has Mercury 7°, Venus 6°, Jupiter 3° and Mars 9°, where the Egyptian terms have Jupiter 7° and Mars 5°: the 7 is O's reading for Jupiter (note b), the 3 the editor's, which makes the five numbers add up to 30° with the 9 of Mars; see the critical notes. Over the twelve signs the terms of Saturn add up to 57°, of Venus to 82° and of Mercury to 76°; those of Jupiter to 75° and of Mars to 70°, with 7° and 5° in Aquarius to 79° and 66°, the five sums making 360°.

Notes on the readings.
